2609.11450.title: Cross-Lingual Clinical Annotation Projection as Constrained Text Generation: A Six-Language Study
2609.11450.paper_summary: Background: To determine whether cross-lingual clinical annotation projection can be formulated as a text-preserving, document-level generative task that produces verifiable character-level annotations for multilingual clinical corpus construction, and to characterize its robustness and computational trade-offs relative to candidate-based projection pipelines. Methods: We developed a constrained LLM projection workflow that inserts entity tags directly into immutable target-language text, followed by deterministic validation and character-offset reconstruction. We evaluated it alongside supervised candidate-span projection and hybrid ML-LLM refinement for transferring Spanish Disease, Symptom, and Procedure annotations into six languages. Evaluation used MultiClinAI gold standard with strict span matching and character-overlap F1 Results: Direct LLM projection achieved the strongest and most consistent performance. GLM 5.2 obtained a mean Strict F1 of 0.9201 across 18 language-entity combinations, while locally deployable Gemma4:31B achieved 0.9133. The best LLM configuration improved Strict F1 over the previous state of the art in all 18 settings, by 0.0564-0.1512, yielding 55,416 grounded mentions with reconstructed offsets. Conclusions: Direct LLM-based projection enables high-quality multilingual clinical annotation transfer and provides a practical approach for extending clinical NLP resources to languages with fewer annotated datasets and language-specific tools. Combined with local inference and deterministic validation, it can substantially reduce expert time and cost for multilingual clinical corpus construction.
2609.11450.paper_summary_zh: 背景：旨在確定跨語言臨床註釋投影是否可以被構建為一個文本保留的、文檔級的生成任務，該任務能夠為多語言臨床語料庫構建生成可驗證的字符級註釋，並描述其相對於基於候選的投影管道的穩健性和計算權衡。<lb/>方法：我們開發了一個受限的 LLM 投影工作流程，該流程將實體標籤直接插入不可變的目標語言文本中，然後進行確定性驗證和字符偏移重建。我們將其與監督式候選跨度投影和混合 ML-LLM 精煉進行了評估，以將西班牙的疾病、症狀和程序註釋轉移到六種語言中。<lb/>評估使用 MultiClinAI 黃金標準，並進行嚴格的跨度匹配和字符重疊 F1。<lb/>結果：直接 LLM 投影實現了最強和最一致的性能。GLM 5.2 在 18 種語言-實體組合中獲得了 0.9201 的平均嚴格 F1，而可本地部署的 Gemma4:31B 則達到了 0.9133。最佳 LLM 配置在所有 18 種設置中將嚴格 F1 提高了 0.0564-0.1512，產生了 55,416 個具有重建偏移的基礎提及。<lb/>結論：直接基於 LLM 的投影能夠實現高質量的多語言臨床註釋轉移，並為將臨床 NLP 資源擴展到標註數據集較少和特定語言工具的語言提供了一種實用的方法。結合本地推理和確定性驗證，它可以大幅減少多語言臨床語料庫構建的專家時間和成本。
